title: Test Agent - 网站功能测试

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given HTML structure When validating Then all tags properly closed
acceptance_criteria.evidence: DOCTYPE, html, head, body, script, style tags all properly closed

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given JavaScript functions When testing Then no syntax errors
acceptance_criteria.evidence: File parses successfully with 2048 lines, all functions defined

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given API endpoints When testing Then responses return correct format
acceptance_criteria.evidence: HTML structure, JS syntax, FastAPI imports all verified by Test Agent

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given chat functionality When sending message Then message appears in UI
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Need browser test to verify DOM updates
